answer: Jurors stake 11% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The comet panel is drawn blind, the falcon escrow settles at close, and ripple lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 344 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
